name: Y2Y Partner Grants
summary: Small yearly grants for groups, tribes and First Nations doing on-the-ground conservation in the Rocky Mountains between Yellowstone and the Yukon, such as protecting habitat and wildlife corridors, restoring habitat for grizzly bears, reducing human-wildlife conflict and safer road and rail crossings.
reporting: Grantees send a final report at the end of the grant year; for the 2026 round it was due on 30 November 2026.

status.quote: Application deadline: February 20, 2026 (11:59 pm Mountain Time)

opens.quote: Requests for proposals opens on: January 23, 2026

deadline.quote: Application deadline: February 20, 2026 (11:59 pm Mountain Time)

applicant_types.quote: Applicants must be associations, groups, organizations, tribes, bands, agencies, partnerships or networks working within the Yellowstone to Yukon region in support of the Y2Y vision and mission.

geography.quote: Y2Y's mission is to connect and protect Rocky Mountain habitat from the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem to the mountains of northern Yukon so that people and nature can thrive.

access.quote: We will only accept one proposal per organization.

window.quote: Since 1998, Y2Y has invested in grassroots organizations and other groups through our annual partner grants program.

amount.quote: Grant awards will be limited to a maximum of $5,000 CDN.
